text:
emma: FYI hit duplicate-create in production. Our python client retried a POST after a 504 and backend accepted both. No Idempotency-Key present.
ryan: ouch. sync or async? which release?
emma: sync, py-sdk 0.9.4. timeout triggered on upload, middleware retried the full request body. backend returned 201 on retry.
noa: do you have a minimal repro?
emma: yes, tiny snippet:
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'), retries=3, timeout=1)
resp = c.post('/v1/widgets', json={'name': 'x'})
```
chris: historically we left idempotency to apps. We should avoid silently changing semantics. Options: warn, opt-in auto-idempotency, or reduce POST retries by default.
ryan: short-term: add runtime warning if method==POST and retries>0 and no Idempotency-Key. Also lower default POST retry count to 1.
noa: long-term: add IdempotencyMiddleware that auto-generates UUIDv4 on retry if body is bufferable and client config auto_idempotency=true. Limit auto-buffer to <=512KB.
emma: async client has its own problem: generator bodies can't be rewinded for replay. I'll take async fix: buffer small bodies, otherwise mark non-replayable and fail fast with message advising idempotency header.
chris: tests: add matrix for sync vs async, small JSON vs stream, explicit id header present vs not, 5xx vs timeout.
ryan: docs: add "Retries & Idempotency" section in quickstart and typing notes on AsyncClient limitations. Also code sample showing how to set Idempotency-Key per request.
noa: created internal repro: https://git.internal/repros/py-dup-replay (private).
devex-bot: Created ticket DE-5120: "py-sdk: duplicate resource on POST retry; idempotency middleware + async replay fix" assigned to emma and noa.
emma: assigning P2. I'll update the customer and add mitigation in support KB.
ryan: I'll file RFC for middleware design; prefer opt-in default and runtime warning for now.
chris: cool. keep me posted on PRs and tests.
emma: thanks all — I'll post status here.
